title: The Coastal Dune Held by Grass
short_teaser: Dune grasses trap sand and stabilize shorelines through extensive roots.
story: Dune grasses trap sand and stabilize shorelines through extensive roots. Small repeated structures can protect a much larger landscape. Nature and place reveal timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of looking closely. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Small repeated structures can protect a much larger landscape. Nature and place reveal timing, interdependence, adaptation, patience, and the value of looking closely.
